locator.section: 8.9 Decompositions of cyclic structures (two bonds cleaved)

evidence.curator_note: GENERIC SCHEME, INSTANTIATED. The page draws a 2,2-disubstituted tetrahydropyran with the substituents written only as R and R'; no m/z and no intensity are printed anywhere in this equation. It is instantiated here as R = R' = CH3 (2,2-dimethyltetrahydropyran, M+. m/z 114.1039) purely so that the record carries a parseable structure - every mass in this record is curator-computed from that choice, not measured. The precursor mapped_smiles localizes charge and odd electron on the ring oxygen exactly as the printed '+.' does (O+ with two sigma bonds carries the one unpaired electron). Book draws 2 arc(s); moves <1,2> are drawn, move <3> is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). Drawn arc 1 = a fishhook from the odd electron on O(1) into the O(1)-C(2) bond; drawn arc 2 = a fishhook from the exocyclic C(2)-R'(8) bond into that same O(1)-C(2) bond, which rises from single to double (cyclic oxocarbenium = 2-alkyltetrahydropyrylium). The undrawn move 3 puts the second electron of the cleaved C(2)-R' bond on R'; the book instead writes '- R'.' under the reaction arrow. Map numbers: 1 = ring O, 2 = C2, 3-6 = ring C3..C6 (C6 is the CH2 bonded to O), 7 = R (retained on the acylium), 8 = R' (expelled).

locator.section: 8.9 Decompositions of cyclic structures (two bonds cleaved)

evidence.curator_note: Book draws 2 arc(s) on the tetrahydropyrylium structure; moves <1,2> are both drawn and no implicit hook is needed - this is an even-electron, charge-site-driven flow and both arrowheads on the page are full (double-barbed) heads, hence electron_count 2. Drawn arc 1 starts on the ring C(2)-C(3) bond and points at the C(2)=O(1) bond, raising it to the acylium triple bond; drawn arc 2 starts on the ring O(1)-C(6) bond and points down-left into the interior of the ring, i.e. at the TRANSANNULAR C(3)-C(6) bond it creates. That new C-C bond is what turns the four remaining ring carbons into the plain square drawn as the neutral product: in skeletal notation the square is cyclobutane (C4H8), and the accompanying text describes the step as the 2-alkyltetrahydropyrylium ion 'dissociating at the C-O ring bond, yielding a stable acylium ion' (also cross-referenced to Equation 8.51; Zahorszky 1982). The reaction arrow itself carries NO letter label on the page; step_class is set to inductive_cleavage because the flow is initiated at the charge site, and that inference (not a printed label) is disclosed here. No m/z or abundance is printed for either product, so both are detected=false and the acylium peak is status 'inferred'.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for equation 8.62 (chapter-8 keys stop at 8.14); no MOD rule variable is cross-linked. Candidates were CHECKED against the instantiated substrate with RDKit rather than asserted. (i) IMS_4_13_1 (DFS '[C]1([H]2)([H]3)([H]4)[C]5([H]6)([H]7)[O+.]8[C]9([H]10)([H]11)[C]12([H]13)([H]14)([H]15)>>[C.]1([H]2)([H]3)([H]4).[C]5([H]6)([H]7){=}[O+]8[C]9([H]10)([H]11)[C]12([H]13)([H]14)([H]15)') has the right geometry for an ether alpha-cleavage (the cleaved C(1)-C(5) bond is incident to the pi-forming carbon C(5)) but is authored for diethyl ether and does NOT match: SMARTS [CH3][C;H2,H3][O+][C;H2,H3][CH3] gives 0 matches on the precursor. (ii) IMS_4_26_1 ('[_A]1[C]2([H]3)([H]4)[O+.]5[_A]6>>[_A.]1.[C]2([H]3)([H]4){=}[O+]5[_A]6') DOES match the substrate (SMARTS [#6][C;H2,H3][O+][#6], 1 match) but only at the UNSUBSTITUTED ring CH2 C(6), where it would break the C(5)-C(6) ring bond and open the ring - NOT the alpha-cleavage drawn here, which cleaves the exocyclic C(2)-R' bond. It cannot reproduce the drawn step because it requires two hydrogens on the alpha carbon and this alpha carbon is fully substituted (verified: SMARTS [O+][C;H2,H3][CH3] gives 0 matches). (iii) No rule encodes the second step (ring C-O cleavage with transannular C-C bond formation to cyclobutane): the nearest acylium-forming rule, IMS_8_8_3, acts on an acyclic oxonium and forms no new C-C bond. Because the scheme prints no measurement, the peak is status 'inferred' with no relative_intensity; ms_context is the book's standard 70 eV EI of the molecular ion, with precursor_mz computed from the R = R' = CH3 instantiation.
